name: jira-toggl-quickstart
description: Chrome extension for Jira and Toggl timers, today's replayable entries, flexible Jira controls, and optional Work Log sync.

scripts.check: node --check background.js && node --check content.js && node --check options.js && node --check popup.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync('manifest.json', 'utf8'))"
scripts.validate: npm run check && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.lint: biome lint --error-on-warnings background.js content.js options.js popup.js scripts tests
scripts.format:check: biome format biome.json manifest.json package.json scripts tests/ci.test.cjs tests/release.test.cjs
